'''2010 US West Nationals Day 2 Brian Hunter DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' One Beautiful Thing
* '''Username:''' Hunter
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2

== Decklist ==

The sheet says the deck is the same as the player's [[2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Brian Hunter DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)|list from the day before]]. The list below is that list.
